diagnosisAndCorrection.rootCause: The rAF callback timestamp and performance.now() were compared as if they shared one clock domain. This Samsung WebView exposed different domains during a window/surface replacement, producing an impossible multi-second frame result beside a single-digit total result.
diagnosisAndCorrection.correction: Both frame endpoints and total time now use performance.now() from one monotonic clock; a permanent source regression test enforces that rule.

updateAndPersistenceObservations.meaning: The corrected artifact was installed with update-in-place semantics and the previously captured user ID, wrapped DEK and archive identity remained unchanged.
